lemma x2611_15379_cor1_2_sigma_aux1
    (g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (hg : g.IsMultiplicative)
    (hgpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n) :
    ∃ f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ,
      (∀ n : ℕ, f n = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, g d) ∧
      f.IsMultiplicative ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < f n) ∧
      (∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → StrictMono (fun m : ℕ => f (p ^ m))) := by
  let f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ := (ArithmeticFunction.zeta : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) * g
  have heq (n : ℕ) : f n = ∑ d ∈ n.divisors, g d :=
    ArithmeticFunction.coe_zeta_mul_apply
  refine ⟨f, heq, ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_zeta.natCast.mul hg, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro n hn
    rw [heq]
    apply Finset.sum_pos'
    · intro d hd
      exact (hgpos d (Nat.pos_of_mem_divisors hd)).le
    · exact ⟨1, Nat.one_mem_divisors.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hn), hgpos 1 (by norm_num)⟩
  · intro p hp
    apply strictMono_nat_of_lt_succ
    intro m
    simp only [heq, Nat.sum_divisors_prime_pow hp, Finset.sum_range_succ]
    exact lt_add_of_pos_right _ (hgpos (p ^ (m + 1)) (pow_pos hp.pos _))

lemma x2611_15379_cor1_2_sigma_aux2 (α : ℝ) :
    ∃ g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ,
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → g n = Real.rpow (n : ℝ) α) ∧
      g.IsMultiplicative ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < g n) := by
  let g : ArithmeticFunction ℝ :=
    ⟨fun n : ℕ => if n = 0 then 0 else Real.rpow (n : ℝ) α, by simp⟩
  have heq (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : g n = Real.rpow (n : ℝ) α := by
    simp only [g, ArithmeticFunction.coe_mk, if_neg (Nat.ne_of_gt hn)]
  refine ⟨g, heq, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply ArithmeticFunction.IsMultiplicative.iff_ne_zero.mpr
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [heq 1 (by norm_num)]
      simpa only [Nat.cast_one, Real.rpow_eq_pow] using Real.one_rpow α
    · intro m n hm hn _
      rw [heq (m * n) (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hm hn)),
        heq m (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hm), heq n (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hn), Nat.cast_mul]
      exact Real.mul_rpow (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (Nat.cast_nonneg n)
  · intro n hn
    rw [heq n hn]
    exact Real.rpow_pos_of_pos (by exact_mod_cast hn) α
